File Unit: Records of Passengers from the Russian Empire, Austria-Hungary, the Netherlands, Scandinavia, and other European Countries, ca. 1820 - ca. 1912
in the Series: Ship Passenger Records, created ca. 1977 - 2010, documenting the period 1820 - 1912. - Collection CGIC (info)

Brief Scope: This series contains information about passengers who arrived in the United States by ship between 1820 and 1912.

You may wish to View the FAQs for this series.

To locate the arrival date, ship name, and port of departure information associated with an individual passenger record, search the Manifest Header Records using the manifest identification number listed in the passenger record. Please refer to the FAQs for more details.
